method: Failed downside break and same-day reclaim of previous 10/20-session low, enter next open, stop at signal low, 3R target, 2/5 day timeout, adverse same-bar stop precedence, 20-30bp costs
limitations: Signal-level pooled trades, NOT a cash-constrained portfolio or benchmarkable portfolio return
Daily OHLC cannot resolve stop-target ordering; assumes stop first
Selection and survivorship bias; multiple hypotheses explored
No short interest data; this is a bull-trap reversal proxy, NOT proven short squeeze
High conviction sizing must NOT be inferred from these statistics
